dream_growth.grows_from: the waking sun at 15:08-15:35 GMT on the bank (the curve between LGT-riverbank-01 and -02) and the muddy rim of the backwater
dream_growth.how: The dream's first open sky: the same high afternoon sun that is shining on the sleeping girl, a little lower than at 2 pm. It dries the party; it never dims toward evening, whatever the birds say (ch003-p47).

schemes.key: high, unobstructed west-south-west sun over the shore
schemes.direction_note: sun high on the WSW side of the set; shadows short and falling ENE; the wood edge behind is lit on its sun side; plan north is fixed by the layout pack, and continuity keeps the sun on the same screen side through the Caucus-race

fill.note: clean blue-sky fill; sparkle and bounce off the still pool

schemes.atmosphere: clear, dry, warm-to-hot still air; wet mud and wet clothes glisten at first, then dry matte
schemes.prompt_fragment_en: Open afternoon sun on a dream shore: a high, hard sun from the west-south-west in a clear summer sky lights the muddy, reed-fringed shore in neutral white daylight, with crisp short shadows under the reeds, sparkle on the still pool, wet mud and dripping clothes glistening, and clean blue-sky fill in the shadows; bright, warm, dry full-afternoon mood, no hint of evening.
schemes.reason: The shore and the drying are explicit (ch003-p01, ch003-p19); no light is described. The sun follows the waking clock (environment S01/S02); S01 and S02 share one condition, so one scheme. The 'night-air' line (ch003-p47) is an excuse, not a light change.
